note: The Conversation France. Academic authors edited by a newsroom, which is a different register from the journals: direct questions and exclamations, the interrogative punctuation formal academic prose barely contains. This is where fr.space-before-high-punctuation meets real question marks. English-language articles in the French feed were dropped by checking the extracted text, since English prose manufactures French findings the publisher never wrote.
